summary_en: This study tests DOC1021, a dendritic cell immunotherapy, in people with refractory melanoma. DOC1021 is injected near nearby lymph nodes two times, two weeks apart, and pIFN (peginterferon alfa-2a) 180 mcg is given under the skin once a week for 4 doses. The study measures safety and tumor responses; Phase 1 checks safety and Phase 2 assesses efficacy.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa DOC1021, una inmunoterapia con células dendríticas, en personas con melanoma refractario. DOC1021 se inyecta cerca de los ganglios linfáticos cercanos en dos ocasiones, con dos semanas de diferencia, y pIFN (peginterferón alfa-2a) de 180 mcg se administra debajo de la piel una vez por semana durante 4 dosis. El estudio mide la seguridad y las respuestas tumorales; la Fase 1 verifica la seguridad y la Fase 2 evalúa la eficacia.
who_for: Unresectable or metastatic melanoma that progressed after at least one prior systemic therapy, including anti-PD-1
Tumor available for biopsy or resection, with enough tissue, and at least one measurable lesion
Willing to withhold anti-PD-1 treatment from enrollment through at least 6 weeks after the first DOC1021 dose
not_for: Known active HIV or hepatitis infection
Systemic autoimmune disorder requiring immunosuppression, or other severe uncontrolled condition
Residual immune-related toxicity from prior immunotherapy above Grade 1
Treatment with another investigational drug within the last 30 days
